tokyo_chatei_zen_kashoin_shibu.price_note: 然花抄院 PUBLISHES A COMPLETE PRICED CARD FOR THIS BRANCH ON TWO PAGES — a sweets page (menu_h) and a drinks page (drink_h) — and both were read in full. Every sweet is quoted 「ドリンク付」, i.e. the price already includes a drink chosen from the drinks page; drinks ordered on their own are priced separately and both figures are recorded below. Four of the seven sweets carry an explicit selling period and 黒蜜法師 adds 「季節商品につき、無くなり次第終了」, so this card is a summer card and will rotate. The sweet names on the page are set as images; they are recovered here from the images' own alt attributes, which match the order of the priced descriptions exactly. ⚠ THE ONE GENUINELY GOOD DISH HERE IS THE わらび餅. The shop states it uses 本わらび粉 — real bracken starch, not the potato-starch substitute most shops use — and warabimochi dressed with kinako and kuromitsu is starch, roasted soy flour and sugar syrup with no wheat and no animal product in it at all. It is recorded gf and vegan and it is the reason to send someone here. ⚠ EVERYTHING BUILT ON かすてら IS THE OPPOSITE. 然花抄院's signature product is a paper-baked castella, and castella is wheat flour, egg and sugar by definition — so 茶庭ノ膳 (a plate of three castellas) and the 菓樂 afternoon tea (eight sweets 「「然」かすてらをはじめ」) are both flatly out on gluten and on egg. ⚠ THE TWO SHAVED ICES NEED A QUESTION EACH. 宇治金時 is served with 抹茶アイス, which is dairy, and 黒蜜法師 hides its contents on purpose — 「かき氷の中に何が隠れているのかは、お楽しみ」 — so neither can be cleared, even though a 黒糖羹 with kuromitsu and kinako sounds vegan on paper. Add-on syrups for the 宇治金時 are 抹茶蜜 +110円 and 練乳 +55円, and 練乳 is condensed milk. Set-drink upgrades are 抹茶 +110円, アイス抹茶ラテ +55円, 室町ソーダ +385円 and アルコール +550円. The page closes 「※その他にも豊富なメニューをご用意しておりますので、詳しくは店舗へお問合せください」 — so this is the published card, not the whole counter.

tokyo_aburi_miso_ramen_mensho_.price_note: SAMURAI NOODLE PUBLISHES ITS FULL MENU IN JAPANESE AND ENGLISH AND PRINTS NO PRICES AT ALL — every line ends in a row of leader dots with the figure omitted, in both languages, and the card closes 「価格は店舗によって異なる場合があります。各店舗のメニューをご確認ください」. So the item list below is authoritative and the prices are simply not published; do not treat the blanks as unresearched. The company's head office is 渋谷区道玄坂2-10-3, the same street as this branch. ⚠ THIS IS ONE OF THE MOST IMPORTANT GLUTEN-FREE ADDRESSES IN THE TOKYO SET AND IT SHOULD BE TREATED AS A PRIORITY FOR PRICE CONFIRMATION. The shop runs a dedicated グルテンフリー section of four bowls — GF味噌, GF辛味噌, GF醤油, GF塩 — plus a ヴィーガン/ベジタリアン section of five, and the two sections overlap in one line, グルテンフリー ヴィーガンラーメン, which is the single dish that satisfies both. The side menu carries GFヴィーガン餃子, GF唐揚げ and GFフライドポテト: a gluten-free gyoza and a gluten-free kara-age are both things that essentially do not exist in ordinary Japanese ramen shops, and a fried item labelled GF implies a fryer the shop is willing to vouch for. ⚠ WHAT THE SHOP DOES NOT PUBLISH IS AS IMPORTANT AS WHAT IT DOES. There is no allergen table, no statement about separate pots or separate fryers, and no ingredient list for the GF tare — and a GF SOY-SAUCE ramen necessarily means a tamari or a wheat-free shoyu that the shop has not named. Everything in the GF section is recorded gf on the strength of the shop's own explicit label and nothing more; the cross-contact question is exactly the one to ask at the counter. ⚠ THE VEGAN BOWLS ARE NOT GLUTEN-FREE unless they are the one line that says so: ヴィーガン味噌, ヴィーガン辛味噌 and ヴィーガン醤油 are vegan ramen on ordinary wheat noodles. オリエンタルベジタリアンラーメン is the Buddhist-style no-alliums bowl and is recorded vegan-ask because oriental vegetarian excludes the five pungent roots but does not by itself exclude egg or dairy.

tokyo_tainan_tantsumen_suidoba.price_note: BOTH OF THE SHOP'S MENU PDFs WERE DOWNLOADED AND RUN THROUGH pdftotext AND NEITHER YIELDED A PRICED CARD. The lunch PDF (1.9 MB) extracts to two bytes — it is an image scan. The dinner PDF (8.9 MB) does extract, but only the English item names: every Japanese string and every price is set in an embedded Adobe-Japan1 CID font that pdftotext cannot map, so the numbers come out as separator glyphs. That is a finding, not a failure — the English dish names below are read from that PDF and are real, but their prices genuinely could not be read from the file. The two priced lines recorded here are the shop's own limited-period campaign images, whose alt text carries the figures: 担仔乾麺セット 850円（税込）and 麻辣湯セット 1,100円（税込）, both marked 【期間限定サービス価格】台南担仔麵水道橋店のみ販売. The twelve おすすめの料理 are named and described in Japanese on the shop's own homepage, unpriced. Also first-party: 宴会 courses with nomihodai from 3,980円, 70 seats, closed Sundays, and the group is シンガポール海南鶏飯グループ. ⚠ THE MOST USEFUL THING ON THIS MENU FOR A COELIAC IS THE 米粉 AND THE RICE. 台湾式焼きビーフン is rice vermicelli and 魯肉飯 and 排骨飯 are rice plates — but 魯肉飯 is braised in soy by definition, the shop itself describes the 担仔麺's traditional topping as 魯蛋、「醤油味のゆで卵」, and 排骨 is a battered fried cutlet. Everything is recorded ask or no; nothing here is established gluten-free. ⚠ THE VEGAN PICTURE IS THIN BUT NOT EMPTY. 干豆腐サラダ (shredded dried tofu, salad-style) and 空心菜炒め, which the shop names in its own description of the evening 台湾酒場 service, are the two plant-based candidates, and 麻婆豆腐 is tofu but is a pork dish as served here. ⚠ 担仔麺 ITSELF IS A WHEAT NOODLE — the shop is careful to explain that 担仔麺 is not 担担麺 and is not spicy, but it is still a wheat noodle in a dashi-style broth topped with simmered pork mince.

tokyo_sangokuichi_nishiguchi_t.price_note: 三国一'S SITE IS LIVE, THE MENU PAGE EXISTS, AND IT SAYS THERE IS NO MENU: 「メニューは現在準備中です。」 — menu currently in preparation. That is the entire content of /menu/, and it was fetched and read in full. This is a confirmed empty, not an unresearched record, and it should not be re-selected until the shop publishes something. ⚠ THE BRANCH ITSELF IS CONFIRMED OPEN, which is the other thing worth banking here. The site's most recent notice (2026.04.07) announces that 三国一東口店 — the EAST exit branch — has closed, and says the company will continue with just 西口店 (03-3344-3591, 新宿区西新宿1-13-10 西新宿昭和ビル) and アイランドイッツ店. This record is the 西口店, so it survives; anyone reconciling this dataset against a stale東口店 listing should treat that one as closed. Hours for 西口店: Mon–Fri 11:00–22:00, Sat 11:00–15:00 / 17:00–21:00, Sun and holidays 11:00–15:00. ⚠ THE SHOP'S BASE STORE WAS DELIBERATELY NOT USED AS A MENU SOURCE. 三国一 sells mail-order udon through udon3591.thebase.in and the homepage previews four products — サラダうどん, おうちうどんすき, 味噌煮込みうどん, 生うどん. Those are retail packets with retail prices and they are not the counter menu; quoting them here would attach the wrong prices to a restaurant record. What they do establish beyond doubt is the category: this is a handmade-udon house, so the noodle is wheat and the tsuyu is a soy-and-dashi tsuyu. No item is recorded because the shop publishes none.

tokyo_container_container_cafe.price_note: container-web.net DOES NOT RESOLVE. Two independent public resolvers — Google 8.8.8.8 and Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 — both return SERVFAIL for the domain, which means the zone's own nameservers are not answering (or the zone is failing DNSSEC validation), not that the name has been withdrawn the way an NXDOMAIN would say. Either way there is no page to fetch from this machine today and no menu has been read. This is distinct from the 渋谷更科 case, where the name is genuinely gone: a SERVFAIL can clear on its own, so this record is worth one cheap retry on a future tick rather than a rewrite. The dataset's only other link is Tabelog, which serves a Cloudflare managed challenge to this egress. Nothing about what CONTAINER serves is established — no dish, no price, no diet flag — and nothing is recorded.

tokyo_bodaiju.price_note: Prices 税込, from the shop's own site (文京区本郷1-14-3 東野ビルB1, a five-minute walk from JR Suidobashi east exit — the record's Hongo/Suidobashi placement). ⚠ IDENTIFICATION WORTH RECORDING: the record files 菩提樹 as 洋食, and it is, but the shop's own copy states its cutlets are 「かつ吉伝統のとんかつ」 — it is run by the かつ吉 group, whose Suidobashi tonkatsu house sits a few hundred metres away at 本郷1-4-1, and roughly half this card is shared with that shop verbatim, including the 大皿盛り platters which are printed here under a 「[菩提樹水道橋店]」 label. Treat the two records as siblings, not duplicates: the addresses, phone numbers and prices differ, and 菩提樹 carries a wagyu-steak and hamburg range the tonkatsu shop does not. ⚠ THE MOST USEFUL SINGLE FINDING IS THE SAUCE CHOICE ON THE HEADLINE DISH, AND IT IS BAD NEWS. The A5 wagyu hamburg — the shop's signature, ground in-house — offers exactly three sauces: デミグラスソース, ガーリックオイル醤油 and わさび醤油. Demi-glace is a wheat roux and the other two are soy sauce, so the shop's flagship dish has no wheat-free dressing on offer. Ask whether it can come plain. ⚠ The cutlets are wrapped in 生パン粉 (fresh wheat breadcrumb) and slow-fried in corn oil, and every fried item on the card shares that oil. Sets come with rice or 青しそご飯, 八丁味噌の赤出汁, salad and pickles — Hatcho miso is a pure soybean miso with no barley, which is a genuine point in its favour, but the dashi under it is bonito. ⚠ Nothing on this card is vegan; 揚げ出し豆腐 and もずく酢 are the only two plant-centred dishes and both are dashi-and-soy dressed.

items.en: Sirloin steak, 200g — ¥5,400 at 250g
items.note: The beef is clean; the sauce is not named on this line. On the sister hamburg dish all three sauce choices are wheat, so ask specifically.

items.ja: 特選牛（国産黒毛和牛）テンダーロインビフテキ定食＜150g＞
items.en: Select black wagyu tenderloin steak set, 150g — ¥5,400 at 200g
items.note: Sauce unnamed — ask, given the shop's stated sauce range is soy and demi-glace.

items.ja: 厳選牛ロース ステーキ定食＜200g＞
items.en: Selected beef sirloin steak set, 200g
items.note: Sauce unnamed. Ask.

items.ja: 厳選牛ロース ビフテキ丼／国産牛フィレ ビフテキ丼
items.romaji: gensen gyū rōsu bifuteki don / kokusan gyū fire bifuteki don
items.en: Beef sirloin or domestic beef fillet steak rice bowl
items.note: A Japanese steak-don sauce is soy-based.

items.ja: 季節の御膳弁当（コーヒー・デザート付）
items.en: Seasonal gozen bento with coffee and dessert
items.note: Composition rotates and is not itemised; on this card it will include fried items.

items.en: Set upgrade — adds rice, red miso soup, salad and pickles to a plate
items.note: The 赤出汁 is 八丁味噌, a pure soybean miso with no barley or wheat in the paste itself — but it is made with a bonito dashi, which is not vegan and normally carries a soy-based seasoning.

items.en: Children's plate
items.note: Composition not published; on this card it will be fried.

items.en: The three-flavour sauce set
items.note: Katsu sauce is a Worcester-style sauce built on wheat-brewed soy or a wheat-containing base.

items.ja: [菩提樹水道橋店]大皿盛り「梅」＜2人前＞
items.en: Sharing platter 'ume' for two — pork fillet katsu, skewered katsu of fillet and vegetables, prawn katsu, seasonal fried vegetables, seasonal shellfish fry and premium pork ginger-fry (¥6,400 for three)
items.note: Everything named is crumbed, battered or soy-glazed. Printed on the card under the shop's own branch label.

items.ja: [菩提樹水道橋店]大皿盛り「松」＜2人前＞
items.en: Sharing platter 'matsu' for two — pork fillet katsu, skewered katsu, prawn katsu, giant wild prawn fry, seasonal shellfish fry and wagyu fillet steak (¥8,980 for three)
items.note: Fried throughout; the wagyu fillet is the only uncrumbed component and its sauce is unstated.

items.en: Thick-cut ginger pork, plate only
items.note: Soy-and-mirin sauce.

items.en: Wagyu hamburg, plate only
items.note: Panko-bound; sauce options are demi-glace or soy.

items.en: Deep-fried tofu in broth
items.note: Agedashi tofu is dusted in flour or potato starch and served in a soy-and-dashi broth — and it goes through the same fryer as the crumbed cutlets.

items.en: House-made fish cake fritters
items.note: Satsuma-age is a fried fish paste routinely bound with wheat starch or flour.

items.ja: 鴨のたたき バルサミコソース
items.en: Seared duck tataki in balsamic sauce
items.note: A balsamic dressing rather than the usual ponzu — worth asking about, because it is one of the few sauces on this card that need not be soy-based.

items.ja: 手作り腸詰め辛口ソーセージ＜74cm＞／自家製ソーセージ
items.romaji: tezukuri chōzume karakuchi sōsēji / jikasei sōsēji
items.en: House-made 74cm spicy sausage coil / house sausage
items.note: House-made, so the binder is the shop's own and is not published. Sausage rusk is a common wheat carrier.

items.en: Select beef tongue grilled with salt
items.note: Named as a salt grill rather than a tare grill, which makes it one of the better prospects on this card. Marinade unpublished — ask.

items.ja: サーモンとアボガドの特製マリネ
items.romaji: sāmon to abokado no tokusei marine
items.en: House marinated salmon and avocado
items.note: Marinade unstated; Japanese marinades often carry soy.

items.en: Crab and tomato salad
items.note: Dressing unstated.

items.ja: A5和牛コロッケ／カニクリームコロッケ
items.romaji: A5 wagyū korokke / kani kurīmu korokke
items.en: A5 wagyu croquette / crab cream croquette
items.note: Croquettes are panko-crumbed, and a cream croquette is bound with a flour béchamel.

items.en: Nanban-style fried young chicken
items.note: Nanban means a flour or batter coating and a sweet-vinegar soy dressing.

items.ja: 一口かつ ひれかつ／海老かつ／若鶏かつ
items.en: Bite-sized katsu — pork fillet, prawn or young chicken
items.note: Crumbed and fried.

items.ja: 自家製燻製 『豚ばら』／『豚とろ』／『鶏レバー』／『鴨ロース』
items.romaji: jikasei kunsei — butabara / butatoro / tori rebā / kamo rōsu
items.en: House smoked pork belly, pork jowl, chicken liver or duck breast
items.note: House-cured; smoking brines in Japan frequently include soy sauce. Not published — ask.

items.en: Oyster, one piece
items.note: Preparation not stated on this line — the card also sells them crumbed and fried. Ask which.

items.en: Aomori mozuku seaweed in vinegar
items.note: Seaweed, but the standard dressing is a vinegar cut with dashi and soy. The one plant-centred dish on the card — ask what the vinegar is made up with.

items.ja: 手作り 特製プリン
items.en: House-made custard pudding — ¥680 with coffee
items.note: Egg and dairy custard; flour content not stated.

items.ja: 菩提樹の酒菜コース＜全7品＞

items.note: Includes a 揚物盛り合わせ (fry platter) — wheat.

items.ja: 菩提樹のご宴会コース＜全8品＞

items.ja: 菩提樹の豪華コース＜全6品＞
items.en: Bodaiju deluxe course, 6 dishes — select beef fillet steak and premium pork fillet katsu (¥8,480 with 2h free drinks)
